scenes.caption: At the airport, and not sure which Wi-Fi to use? Start with WiFi Scout.
Run WiFi Scout. Open the local dashboard.
Start with the venue’s name. Confirm you’re allowed to use it and have any needed credentials. Then scan.
A familiar name. Conflicting settings. WiFi Scout withholds its recommendation.
Understand the concern. Same name. Different protection. See the warning straight away.
Open the evidence. Compare the advertised settings behind the warning.
Ask staff for another option. Confirm the café’s Wi-Fi name and access details.
A clearer next step. A best observed candidate, with reasons and limits.
Know why it was suggested. Read the reasons. You decide whether to connect.
Curious about the details? Inspect the individual access-point observations.
Compare the clues. Confirm the network with staff. A scan cannot verify its operator. You decide whether to connect.
